regō

regō, regere, rēxī, rēctum

verb, third conjugation

control, guide, run; rule, govern, direct

In this lexicon

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Sen. 37: tantam domum … Appius regēbat; Liv. 35.11: impotentēs regendī equī (Lewis & Short)

  • rule

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Rosc. Am. 131: cum sōlus rem pūblicam regeret (Lewis & Short); Cic. Sen. 37: tantam domum … Appius regēbat; Traupman 180, 373
